show.description: Ishq Aaj Kal - follows five Mumbai dreamers whose lives intertwine through love, ambition, and heartbreak. Ishaan seeks acceptance, Isha chases fame, Naina faces a broken marriage, Shiraz struggles as a songwriter, and Armaan confronts his past. Each must choose between- love or money, dreams or society, the heart or the world.
